name: Nurhachius
sum: Istiodactylid from the Jiufotang Formation of Liaoning, China, close to the English Istiodactylus.
wsnote: 2.4–2.5 m (describers); Witton estimated 2.28 m and 4 kg.
holotype: IVPP V-13288 (N. ignaciobritoi) — Jiufotang Formation, Chaoyang, Liaoning.
material: Partial skull and most of the skeleton; second species N. luei from a skull, jaws and neck.
biology: Laterally compressed, three-rooted teeth at the jaw tips, similar to Istiodactylus.
author: Wang et al. 2005
